checks.name: manifest_top_level
checks.summary: required frozen top-level manifest fields present

checks.name: config_identity
checks.summary: config file exists and sha256 matches manifest

checks.name: waveform_frozen
checks.summary: waveform block and clipping headroom match frozen contract/config

checks.name: split_plan
checks.summary: split/session/file plan matches frozen config; families disjoint

checks.name: npz_file_sha256
checks.summary: every npz sha256 matches the manifest

checks.name: npz_arrays
checks.summary: required arrays, dtypes and shapes present

checks.name: frame_metadata
checks.summary: frame_id/session_id/label/seed_family metadata consistent

checks.name: exact_frame_reconstruction
checks.summary: every frame rebuilt byte-for-byte from recorded seeds/params

checks.name: iq_sha256
checks.summary: per-frame iq_sha256 matches stored bytes

checks.name: clipping_flags
checks.summary: clipped flag matches pre-saturation out-of-range detection

checks.name: parameter_ranges
checks.summary: per-frame parameters within frozen ranges / sigma formula exact

checks.name: amplitude_safety_cap
checks.summary: amplitude_codes respects the frozen clipping-safety cap

checks.name: snr_residual
checks.summary: measured residual noise variance matches sigma (quantisation aware)

checks.name: snr_grid
checks.summary: test snr grid exact; train/val snr within uniform range

checks.name: seed_uniqueness_and_duplicates
checks.summary: RNG seeds unique per frame; no cross/intra split duplicate IQ

checks.name: gate_clip_rails
checks.summary: gate CLIP frames saturated, flagged and contain rail codes

checks.name: rotated_component_bound
checks.summary: after receiver phase/CFO rotation max(|I|,|Q|) <= amplitude_codes everywhere (complex-envelope bound, +1 code)

checks.name: clipped_statistics
checks.summary: clipped counts match the stored frames

checks.name: summary_counts
checks.summary: frame counts, per-split totals and file entries match frozen plan

checks.name: bit_mapping_vs_contract_and_product
checks.summary: all bit patterns match the frozen contract/product mapper

checks.name: noiseless_quantization
checks.summary: clean max|I+jQ| == amplitude_codes; rotated component peak <= amplitude; np.rint ties-to-even correct

checks.name: constellation_power_coefficients
checks.summary: analytic c matches measured (synthetic probes + dataset aggregate)
